qualification.scopeNote: Original #770 checks passed, but unrelated Contracts/Store database harnesses did not establish Attendance-specific R3 acceptance; the supplemental qualification below closes that gap.

delivered: Staff Attendance selected persistence moved behind an Attendance-owned repository contract and Supabase adapter.
Scanner replay, game-scoped Player/credential lookup, attendance-window read and atomic attendance mutation invocation moved out of the application persistence seam.
The existing admin_record_attendance_v1 transaction remains the sole Staff Attendance mutation boundary.
Reward policy decisions and HTTP/application response translation remain in their existing owners.
Architecture inventory records one fewer persistence-outside-infrastructure site without increasing compatibility-marker debt.

acceptedCases: in-RPC failure after reward writes rolls back all effects and replay receipt; same-key retry succeeds
same-key concurrent replay with two observed database lock waiters
different-key same-player/day race with two observed waiters and exactly one attendance/reward transaction

historicalFailure.reason: Synthetic game_settings fixture omitted required stock-market timezone; corrected without changing runtime, schema or assertions.

attendanceDatabaseQualification.scope: Repository/disposable-database acceptance only; no hosted mutation or production certification.
